phases.objective: Add a fail-closed, no-secret, read-only Production privilege verification path for the dedicated Governance DB writer without provisioning accounts, grants, secrets, deployment, or migration apply authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Repository privilege matrix evaluator and exact-head manual readiness workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repository can prove the exact required table privilege matrix and fail closed on missing or broader privileges; the live workflow remains manual, exact-Production-SHA-bound, secret-safe, and read-only.
steps: Load the repository-defined Governance DB privilege matrix.
Accept normalized information_schema privilege rows without a database connection in synthetic regression coverage.
Prove the exact required table privileges are accepted.
Reject missing required privileges, schema-wide privileges, unexpected global privileges, unrelated table scopes, and extra operations on allowed tables.
Keep failure evidence bounded and secret-free.
Require an exact Production branch SHA and explicit confirmation token before the live workflow reaches the secret-bearing probe step.
Require the merged Governance Production Environment Authority preflight before live privilege readback.
Use only connection ping, CURRENT_USER/DATABASE consistency readback, and information_schema privilege metadata in the live probe.
Do not create users, execute GRANT, mutate application rows, deploy, restart, or run migration SQL in this source slice.
assertions: The required privilege matrix is identical to the reviewed #6813 Production contract.
The synthetic evaluator fails closed when any required privilege is missing.
The synthetic evaluator fails closed on any schema-wide privilege or unexpected global privilege.
The synthetic evaluator fails closed on unrelated table/schema grants and extra privileges on allowed tables.
The live workflow requires the exact current Production SHA before the database probe step.
The live probe composes with resolveGovernanceProductionPreflight() and therefore cannot treat main as Production authority or reuse runtime DB credentials as Governance credentials.
Probe output contains no MariaDB username, password, host, database name, raw grant rows, or secret values.
No Production SQL mutation, CREATE USER, GRANT, provider mutation, deployment, restart, or Migration 1050 readiness/apply is performed by CI for this PR.

phases.objective: Run the read-only privilege probe against the separately provisioned dedicated Governance DB writer on the exact Production source.
blockers: Dedicated MariaDB Governance writer principal and reviewed table-scoped grants must be provisioned through separate Production administrative authority.
Production GOVERNANCE_DB_* secrets must be configured through the governed secret path.
The repaired source and this readiness tooling must be promoted through the normal main to Production lifecycle.
The manual Governance DB Privilege Readiness workflow has not yet passed on the exact Production SHA.
